latHint: Think nudging someone for an answer - not squeezing apples.
pivHint: A cider PRESS squeezes the fruit - but to PRESS someone for an answer means to do what?
winText: No more waiting. PRESS was the pivot - apple squeezing to giving a firm NUDGE.
lossText: NUDGE - to PRESS gently. PRESS was the pivot: cider PRESS to nudging for an answer.
